title: 新建版式
description: Creates a layout with its own name. It is offered at the foot of the 母版与版式 rail, and in the page's 版式 section when the deck has no layout yet.

kimiUi.location: 左侧「母版与版式」列表底部；无版式文稿时在页面「版式」区
kimiUi.appearsWhen: on a layout or master surface, or on a page of a deck with no layout

preconditions.notes: Committed as test-fixtures/layouts-project, which already has layouts. The no-layout case needs a deck without layouts.

pptd.summary: layoutCreate adds a layout definition to the PPTD document

selfTestChecklist: a deck without layouts offers 新建版式 in the 版式 section
a list row selects its layout or the master, and 新建版式 creates one
